name: Admin — dashboard reports system-wide analytics

planSteps.description: The page heading reads "Analytics Dashboard" with the subtitle "CENRO Cabuyao system-wide overview"
A Total Reports figure is shown as a number, with a breakdown naming complaints, wildlife and requests
Cards for Users, Avg Resolution and Endangered Wildlife each show a numeric value
A "Reports over time" chart is rendered with month labels on its axis
SLA compliance cards are shown as percentages for complaints, wildlife and requests

description: The admin analytics dashboard reports system-wide figures: total reports broken down by kind, user and resolution-time cards, a six-month reports-over-time chart, and SLA compliance percentages per report type.
